blocks.text: Beadpress reduces a once more elaborate preparation to a lever and a few counted beads. The form remembers measuring and dispensing; the game keeps its name simple and asks the caretaker to read what the dose treats.
A crescent press holding amber beads. Push its lever to dispense them.
One-shot use: The lever presses down and the beads dispense as a thick falling stream, leaving an empty crescent. The game performs the final fade.
24 silver. Infection severity −2; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +8. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image cd77d10a-94ae-4a40-863e-cd857ca3adee; animation 1ae14b49-f6c3-42b2-95aa-bc0aa85a72b9. Reduced motion holds a still.
